It's likely scaled down version of Russian Supercavitation torpedo VA-111 Shkval created back in 1970. Iranian version can reach 460km/h latest Russian version 640km/h beside them South Korea also has them.  #ufotwitter 

In fact, since 2016, the Russians have begun producing versions that can reach 640 km/h. Keep in mind that this is still classified technology in Russia, even if it was created 56 years ago.

I am convinced that a few other countries possess this type of missile: South Korea, the United States, Germany, and Japan. He is not telling the whole truth.
